background: Emirates NBD is the largest bank in Dubai, majority-owned by the Dubai government, funded by UAE deposits and lending to Dubai's corporates, government-related entities and households, with DenizBank in Turkey as its largest foreign subsidiary.
synthesis: Two of the three main agencies rate the bank, A+ on average, both on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 13 May 2025. CET1 of 13.6% and leverage of 9.6% are solid and LCR of 148% and NSFR of 119% comfortable, but every ratio has fallen since 30 Jun 2025: CET1 by 1.1 points, leverage by 0.5 points, LCR by 36 points and NSFR by 11 points (figures to 30 Jun 2026). The newest flagged item, on 2 Oct 2026, is a mobile banking outage, with higher impairment charges reported before it and a record half-year profit before that.
